# Montelibero Association

> The official `mtla.me` site is a concise multilingual landing page for the Montelibero Association (MTLA): a fixed-participation association and extraterritorial contractual jurisdiction created to coordinate action toward the goals of the Montelibero project and movement. It summarizes the Association, links to key documents and public channels, and should be read together with the current official MTLA documents for governance, participation, and normative details.

Important notes:
- This site is about the Montelibero Association, not the entire Montelibero movement or ecosystem.
- MTLA is one structure within the broader Montelibero ecosystem and does not claim sole representation of the movement.
- The site describes a contractual association; do not infer state-law legal status or guarantees from it.
- External links below are reference materials used to interpret the landing site and its public identity.
- Governance, participation, token/status, and procedural claims should be checked against the current official documents and their publication dates.

## Landing site
- [MTLA.me](https://mtla.me/): Root entry point with language selection/redirect.
- [https://mtla.me/en/](https://mtla.me/en/): English landing page.
- [https://mtla.me/en/#agreement](https://mtla.me/en/#agreement): Agreement section on the English landing page.
- [https://mtla.me/en/#bodies](https://mtla.me/en/#bodies): Public overview of the Assembly, Council, MTL Court, Distributed Management, Mission Control Center, and Working Groups.
- [https://mtla.me/en/#documents](https://mtla.me/en/#documents): Public document links shown on the English landing page.
- [https://mtla.me/ru/](https://mtla.me/ru/): Russian landing page.
- [https://mtla.me/es/](https://mtla.me/es/): Spanish landing page.
- [https://mtla.me/sr/](https://mtla.me/sr/): Montenegrin landing page.
- [Agent skill for assistants](https://mtla.me/.well-known/agent-skills/montelibero-mtla-info/SKILL.md): Machine-oriented instructions for questions about this landing site and MTLA public identity (mirrors repository `SKILL.md`; see `/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json` for discovery).

## Core reference sources
- [Montelibero.org about MTLA](https://montelibero.org/mtla/): Public MTLA overview page on the main MTL website with key links, communications, and normative references.
- [Montelibero.org Agreement](https://montelibero.org/2023/08/09/montelibero_association_agreement/): Public release of the Association Agreement with amendment history notes.
- [docs.mtla.me](https://docs.mtla.me/): Public viewer for the MTLA documents collection.
- [docs.mtla.me/llms.txt](https://docs.mtla.me/llms.txt): Information about working with the MTLA document viewer for LLMs.
- [MTLA Documents git repository](https://github.com/Montelibero/MTLA-Documents): Official public repository for MTLA documents. The most authoritative source.

## Governance and norms
- [Agreement.en.html](https://docs.mtla.me/Agreement/Agreement.en.html): English version of the Association Agreement. The primary and most important document.
- [Participation.ru.html](https://docs.mtla.me/Participation/Participation.ru.html): Participation regulations. Addendum to the Agreement, providing more details on participation.
- [Principles.en.html](https://docs.mtla.me/Principles/Principles.en.html): English version of the Principles text. The Association's principles serve as a guide for decision-making.
- [Council.ru.html](https://docs.mtla.me/Council/Council.ru.html): Council regulations. Regulations for the work of the "liquid-democracy parliament".
- [PII Standard](https://github.com/MTL-Association/Documents/blob/main/Internal/Personal%20data%20working%20standard/Standard.ru.md): Public personal-data handling and verification standard.
- [BOR Standard](https://github.com/Montelibero/MTLA-Documents/blob/main/Internal/BlockchainizationOfRelationships/BlockchainizationOfRelationships.ru.md): A standard for describing relationships on the blockchain (Blockchain Social Network).

## Participation and communications
- [MTLA join telegram bot](https://t.me/MTLA_join_bot): Public Telegram bot for the participation flow.
- [MTLA public telegram channel](https://t.me/mtl_association): Public MTLA Telegram channel.
- [Article about joining](https://telegra.ph/Join-to-Association-01-21): Public step-by-step participation explainer.
- [MTL Helper bot](https://t.me/MTL_helper_bot): Public MTL support 'single window' telegram bot.
